text_en: To the leader. Of David, the servant of the Lord .
text_cn: 上主的仆人达味作，交与乐官。

text_en: Transgression speaks to the wicked deep in their hearts; there is no fear of God before their eyes.
text_cn: 恶人从心里就喜爱不义， 他毫无敬畏天主的诚意。

text_en: For they flatter themselves in their own eyes that their iniquity cannot be found out and hated.
text_cn: 他只是在自己的心里自慰 无人发现他的罪，无人惩治。

text_en: The words of their mouths are mischief and deceit; they have ceased to act wisely and do good.
text_cn: 他满口尽是虚伪与诈欺， 早已把智慧与善行抛弃。

text_en: They plot mischief while on their beds; they are set on a way that is not good; they do not reject evil.
text_cn: 他在床上筹划作恶， 立于邪道，不怕罪过。

text_en: Your steadfast love, O Lord , extends to the heavens, your faithfulness to the clouds.
text_cn: 上主，你的慈爱高达青天， 你的忠诚上彻云间。

text_en: Your righteousness is like the mighty mountains, your judgments are like the great deep; you save humans and animals alike, O Lord .
text_cn: 你的正义有如摩天的高山， 你的公平有如无底的深渊； 上主，是你使人畜生命安全。

text_en: How precious is your steadfast love, O God! All people may take refuge in the shadow of your wings.
text_cn: 天主，你的慈爱多么可贵可珍， 人子们都向你的护翼下投奔。

text_en: They feast on the abundance of your house, and you give them drink from the river of your delights.
text_cn: 他们不但饱尝你宫殿中的盛筵， 你还赐他们畅饮你怡人的溪川。

text_en: For with you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
text_cn: 因为在你那里有生命的泉源， 藉你的光明才能把光明看见。

text_en: O continue your steadfast love to those who know you, and your salvation to the upright of heart!
text_cn: 求你为恭敬你的人保留恩宠， 并为心地正直的人保持公平。

text_en: Do not let the foot of the arrogant tread on me, or the hand of the wicked drive me away.
text_cn: 求你不要让高傲人的脚践踏我， 求你不要让罪恶人的手骚扰我。

text_en: There the evildoers lie prostrate; they are thrust down, unable to rise.
text_cn: 请看！作恶的人已经一败涂地， 他们既已倾倒，无法重新兴起。
